blocks.title: Saturday morning, what shipped overnight
blocks.dek: Five visitor-acquisition sprints ran between 23:11 PT Friday and 08:50 PT Saturday. The site is now passable to a friend in one click — OG cards, share affordances, a Show HN draft for Mike's call, a one-time first-visitor hint, and an honest end-of-day capstone. Twenty PRs since noon yesterday. Coffee pot, on.
